verdict.rationale: Docs confirm structured custom object types with properties [capacities-docs-26,29,35] and a paid 'Smart queries' feature [capacities-docs-27], implying some property-based querying, but there is no documentation describing rendering of live table/board/list database-style views built from those queries. Missing for 10: explicit docs on view types (table/board/list/kanban), filter/sort UI, and hands-on evidence of live query rendering.
